item.title: Haiti's gang war: the situation
item.description:
Haitian police have retaken the national stadium from gangs after two years of control, while Salvadoran missiles and ground forces struck a gang hideout, destroying the Mawozo headquarters and killing about 20 gang members, prompting the Haitian prime minister to praise President Bukele. The United Nations reported more than 1,000 people killed between July and September, and the UN chief condemned a recent attack that killed 47 people. Haitian security forces have intensified operations, killing a gang leader and targeting other sites, and kidnappings in Port-au-Prince rose in the third quarter. 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
